Original colored right wall/window/mullion assignments preserved; new pale returns are confined to original aperture surfaces.
Broad roof and approximate plant stay neutral; two original roof-well floors retain metal proxy. Original tan terrace floor and round rim intact, artificial square-cut walls remain neutral.

Same rear camera and lighting as revised rear. Clearly shows original entire left wall/window/mullion assembly neutral and rear neutral; revised fixes left family and only bounded rear upper beam.
